name: White Dragon Firelord

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Fire and Ice
traits.details: while within the aura, enemies gain vulnerable 15 cold and vulnerable 15 fire.

traits.name: Elemental Affinity
traits.details: The white dragon firelord’s elemental power overcomes the fire affinity of the City of Brass. The dragon’s attacks with the cold keyword deal full damage.

auras.name: Fire and Ice
auras.details: while within the aura, enemies gain vulnerable 15 cold and vulnerable 15 fire.

hit.description: plus 2d12 cold damage (plus an extra 2d12 cold damage on a successful opportunity attack)

effect.description: The dragon makes two claw attacks. If the dragon hits a single target with both claws, it makes a bite attack against the same target

hit.description: cold and fire damage, and the firelord slides the target 2 squares
cold and fire damage, and the target is knocked prone and blinded (save ends both)

effect.description: The dragon’s breath weapon recharges, and the dragon uses it.

powers.name: Frightful Presence
powers.description: The target takes a –2 penalty to attack rolls (save ends)

hit.description: the target is stunned until the end of the dragon’s next turn.

aftereffects.name: Aftereffect
aftereffects.description: The target takes a –2 penalty to attack rolls (save ends)

powers.name: Steam Shroud
powers.trigger: when hit by a melee attack

effect.description: The dragon’s space and all adjacent squares become a zone of roiling steam that grants total concealment until the end of the dragon’s next turn.
